indicator_name: National Fund operations and its holdings of Kazakh issuers' instruments
description: Операции Национального фонда и финансовые инструменты казахстанских эмитентов в его портфеле
methodology: NBK formId=470, monthly from 2024-02, dated report_date. DEBT_* = bonds of Kazakh issuers (quasi-public: Baiterek, KSF, Samruk-Kazyna and others) held by the National Fund -- the NF's financing of the quasi-public sector; EQUITY_* mainly the Samruk-Kazyna/KazMunayGas shares. TRANSFERS = the scalar NATIONAL_FUND_TRANSFERS. Units differ by item (see item_name).
